parameters.query: INSERT INTO rejected_events (reason, payload_excerpt) VALUES ($1::text, $2::text) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO alert_deliveries (execution_id, receiver, group_key, alert_count, payload)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::integer, $5::jsonb)
RETURNING id AS delivery_id

-- Always one row per alert: NULL columns mean the service is not in the catalog.
SELECT s.owner, s.runbook, s.page_severities
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS service) AS q
LEFT JOIN service_catalog AS s ON s.service = q.service

-- ON CONFLICT takes a row lock, so concurrent deliveries of the same alert apply one at a time,
-- and each one sees the row the previous one left (RETURNING old/new needs PostgreSQL 18).
INSERT INTO incidents AS i (fingerprint, alertname, service, namespace, severity, status, summary,
                            starts_at, owner, runbook, enrichment, notify_status, resolved_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::text, $8::timestamptz,
        $9::text, $10::text, $11::text, $12::text, CASE WHEN $6::text = 'resolved' THEN now() END)
ON CONFLICT (fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET
  occurrences = i.occurrences + CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'firing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  status      = EXCLUDED.status,
  resolved_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'resolved' THEN now() ELSE i.resolved_at END,
  last_seen   = now(),
  -- A failed notification is retried by the next delivery of the same alert (Alertmanager repeat or replay).
  notify_status = CASE WHEN i.notify_status = 'failed' THEN 'pending' ELSE i.notify_status END
RETURNING new.*,
  (old.id IS NULL) AS created,
  ((old.id IS NULL AND new.notify_status = 'pending') OR coalesce(old.notify_status = 'failed', false)) AS should_notify

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ incident_id: $json.id, title: `[${$json.severity}] ${$json.alertname} on ${$json.service}`, summary: $json.summary, service: $json.service, namespace: $json.namespace, owner: $json.owner, runbook: $json.runbook, starts_at: $json.starts_at, occurrences: $json.occurrences }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE incidents SET notify_status = 'sent', notified_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING id, notify_status

WITH failed AS (
  UPDATE incidents SET notify_status = 'failed' WHERE id = $1::bigint RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO dead_letters (stage, delivery_id, incident_id, execution_id, error)
SELECT 'notify', $2::bigint, failed.id, $3::text, $4::text FROM failed
RETURNING id AS dead_letter_id, incident_id
